title: Supplies for the Village
dialogOffer: We're short on building materials. Bring me 3 Wood and 2 Stone and I'll reward you.
dialogActive: Still need 3 Wood and 2 Stone. Chop trees and mine rocks out there!
dialogComplete: Wonderful, just what we needed. Here, take these for your trouble.
dialogTurnedIn: Thanks again for the supplies, friend.
